metadata.title: Ballard repair | Keep gear in use
metadata.description: Learn how the Ballard repair intake process works.

props.headline: Use leaves a record.
props.description: A torn cuff or failed closure doesn't always end the useful life of your gear. Eligibility, pricing, and turnaround depend on inspection.

props.heading: Three steps, then an answer.
props.introduction: This test flow describes the decision process without promising eligibility, cost, or timing.

steps.title: Send the details
steps.description: Provide the gear name, purchase information, damage location, and clear photographs.

steps.title: We inspect the request
steps.description: The repair team checks construction, damage, available materials, and whether the work is feasible.

steps.title: Review the next action
steps.description: You receive the approved options, cost, and expected timing before work begins. Terms are [TBD: approval needed].
